intro: Meal planning reduces decision fatigue. You decide once when you have calm — then execute on busy days when willpower is tired.
buddyTip: Plan fewer meals than you think. Two reliable dinners and a default lunch beat a colourful schedule you abandon.
mission: Write tomorrow’s lunch and dinner before bed — realistic foods already in the house or on tomorrow’s shop path.
why: Unplanned evenings default to the easiest delivery app. That is not a character flaw; it is empty fridge plus fatigue. Planning is environmental design.
Plans are intent — not the live diary. You still log what you actually eat on Home. If the plan changes, the log tells the truth; the plan simply made a good default available.
Planning also supports protein and fibre consistency. When anchors are pre-decided, you stop hoping lunch “somehow” becomes high-protein.

what.lead: What a good plan includes — and excludes.
points: A short list of dinners you can cook in your real time budget
A default breakfast and lunch pattern for weekdays
Protein and fibre called out explicitly
One flexible slot for restaurants or leftovers
A shop list that matches the plan — not aspirational recipes you’ll never cook

misconceptions.myth: If I deviate from the plan, I failed.
misconceptions.truth: Plans guide. Logs record. Deviation is data — update next week’s plan.
Meal Plan is forward-looking. Foodiary/Home capture what happened. Both matter.

steps: Check calendar: late nights, training, travel, social meals
Pick 2–4 dinners; repeat favourites on purpose
Assign protein anchors to breakfast/lunch defaults
Write the shop list from the plan only
Enter intent in Meal Plan if you use it; log reality on Home when you eat
Sunday review: which planned meals actually happened?
how.buddyHelps: Meal Plan holds intent and can support shopping helpers. Home logging keeps Progress honest when life edits the plan.

sections.title: Templates over novelty
paras: Rotation beats novelty for adherence. Keep a personal “greatest hits” list of 8–10 meals.
Introduce at most one new recipe per week while habits are forming.

sections.title: Family and Spaces
paras: If you cook for others, plan shared bases (protein + carb + veg) with optional sauces so one kitchen serves many preferences.
Scale Health Success starts at the dinner table — planning makes healthy the path of least resistance for more than one person.

mistakes.quote: I planned seven gourmet dinners and ordered pizza on Tuesday.
mistakes.why: Overambitious plans collapse. Match cooking skill and time.
A plan without a list is a wish. Shop the same day you plan when possible.

mistakes.quote: I logged the plan instead of what I ate.
mistakes.why: That corrupts Progress. Log reality; keep the plan as a guide.

encouragement: A humble plan you follow most days will outperform a perfect menu you admire. Decide tonight’s default — future-you will thank you.
